== virtualUSB

- Fixed an issue where only the most recently paired iOS device connected to Xcode when more than one iOS 17.4 or later device was used through virtualUSB on the same Mac. Previously, after connecting a second device, reconnecting the first device left it stuck while connecting, and it never appeared in Xcode.
- Fixed an issue where a device that was no longer paired with the Mac never connected.
- virtualUSB no longer shows a device as *Connected* while it is still waiting for the Mac to connect.

The fix applies to the virtualUSB macOS app and requires updated virtualUSB and deviceConnect versions. After the update, one previously paired device on each Mac may need to be unpaired once.
